title: The claude-subscription replay misses on Claude Code 2.1.283, because the replay credentials name no account
foundBy: session agent, replaying the cassettes re-recorded for the move to sandbox d9279e7 and Claude Code 2.1.283

evidence.verified: `make ci` passed on cac0cb2. TestSmokeReplay/claude-subscription passed, and its cs-vcr summary read 47 requests and 0 misses. The other 8 scenarios passed too.

resolution: The cs-vcr ruleset v15 removes the account reminder whole when cutting the address leaves it empty, on both sides of a replay (VCR-042 in cs-vcr). Campaign took it by moving its cs-vcr pin in c8fd7b4 and re-recording in cac0cb2. The fabricated credential tree is unchanged.
details:
Recorded on Claude Code 2.1.283, the claude-subscription scenario fails in `make test-smoke`. Both members miss at their second request with `messages[0].content: 4 items vs 3`, so the campaign never reaches its verdict.

A lent Claude login carries the host's `oauthAccount`, address included, into the member. A recording runs on the real profile, so the member knows an address, and Claude Code writes it into a `# userEmail` section of a system reminder. The recorder, cs-vcr, strips that section and keeps the reminder. The replay's fabricated credential tree holds a token and no account, so the member knows no address and sends no reminder.

Claude Code 2.1.258 was not affected, because that reminder also carried `# claudeMd` and `# currentDate`. In 2.1.283 the address is all it holds. Sandbox fixed the same defect in its own replay tier as SBX-086.

notes.text: The fix moved to cs-vcr. Its ruleset v15 removes the account reminder whole when cutting the address leaves it empty, on both sides (VCR-042). Campaign takes it by moving its cs-vcr pin, and its fabricated credential tree stays as it was.
